Classify panel membership and store it as label rules

classify_panel.Rd

Runs panel_describe() on df and adds two label rules keyed by entity: panel_type (persistent/entrant/exit/transient/empty) and panel_spell (seamless/segmented). Filter on them via, e.g., apply_sfw(df, sfw, panel_type = "persistent").

Usage

classify_panel(sfw, df, method = c("describe"))

Arguments

sfw

A sample frame.

df

A panel data frame with the frame's entity and time key columns.

method

Classifier to use. Currently "describe".

Value

The updated sample frame.
